title: Estimated due dates read as a month with confidence
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. A unit whose services are due from meter estimates, plus a compliance date and a calendar date; "Enter mileage" is available above the cards. Seed readings so at least one service is due from a mileage estimate.
custom_steps:
1. Read how an estimated due date is shown (month, confidence, hover rule).
  2. Read an overdue meter-estimate row, a certificate-term date, and a calendar date.
  3. Use Enter mileage to record a reading and watch the dependent services.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every estimated due date shows a month, at every confidence, with its confidence beneath (the meter and a word - High/Medium/Low confidence) and the rule (e.g. "based on mileage estimate") in the meter's hover; an exact date belongs to a recorded reading alone.
  • An overdue row from a meter estimate shows its estimated month and no figure (never "overdue by 1,200 mileage"); a certificate-term date reads its month and "Certificate"; a calendar date reads its month and "Calendar".
  • Entering a reading recalculates every dependent service immediately.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S9 (confidence display copied from S11); read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R9: “Every estimated due date shows a month, at every confidence, with its confidence beneath it as the meter and a word: High, Medium or Low confidence. The rule that produced it ... sits in the meter's hover ... An exact date belongs to a recorded reading alone”
  • S11-R13: “An overdue row derived from a meter estimate shows its estimated month and carries no figure at any confidence: never overdue by 1,200 mileage. A date from a certificate term reads its month and Certificate ... A date from the calendar reads its month and Calendar”
  • S9-E2: “Entering a reading here recalculates every dependent service immediately”
